name: Piper Mhairi

intro.text: I play the pipes on the sea wall at six o'clock every evening. A seal comes to listen. Some say it's to escape. I say it's the music.

win: Nice work. The seal's behind you, looking at you disapprovingly.
after: The Highland bagpipe has three drones and a chanter. It is the loudest instrument in the world that is not a car alarm.
